description: H1R2 C1: routes of the inventory (scripts/ops/extract_routes.mjs) that are NOT operations of docs/api/openapi.json, one entry per (method, route) with the reason. Checked by test/unit/h1r2_c1_openapi_route_coverage.test.ts: no wildcard, no stale entry, no sensitive route (admin, SCIM, keys, billing, export/GDPR, webhooks, tenants, teams, gateway) among the undocumented ones. Prefer documenting the route over adding an entry here.

dispatchers.reason: version prefix: cuts one leading /v1 and continues with the same handlers (documented in info.description)
dispatcher of the export job routes: resolves the caller (401) and hands over to POST /data/export and GET /data/export/status/{jobId}
SSO dispatcher: loads the SAML provider and hands over to /auth/saml/metadata and /auth/saml/acs
delegation to src/auth/scim/ScimRouter.ts (its routes are documented one by one)
SCIM bearer gate (401 for every SCIM path) before the Users/Groups handlers; documented on each SCIM operation
webhook dispatcher: 401 without credential, then the list/create/by-id handlers (reachable at /v1/v1/webhooks..., NF-15)
GDPR dispatcher: admin:gdpr RBAC (legacy admin key with auth off) before export/erase
flags dispatcher: platform check (admin:flags) before the flag handlers
dashboard dispatcher: delegates to src/dashboard/login.ts and src/dashboard/app.ts
tenant gate of the dashboard (auth on, non-platform caller): 401 without tenant, 403 platform_operation_forbidden for platform-wide pages
same tenant gate line as /app/webhooks (dashboard JSON API)
price dispatcher: platform check (admin:chain-head) before GET /v1/admin/prices and POST /v1/admin/prices/refresh
